verdict.rationale: Postman documents Agent Mode, which turns natural-language instructions into actions across the API lifecycle: sending requests, fixing errors, updating tests, visualizing responses and writing documentation. An official MCP server also lets external agents operate Postman, and Postbot provides further AI assistance, though its free tier is capped at 50 activities per month and fuller use needs a paid add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Agent Mode works reliably, in-depth documentation of which operations are covered, and unrestricted access beyond Postbot's usage cap and paid add-on.
